questions.question: When it is hard for other drivers to see your vehicle, such as at dawn or dusk, what should you do?

options.text: Wave your arm out the window.

questions.explanation: When visibility is low, turn on your headlights to low beam. If you cannot see others, they cannot see you either.

questions.question: What part of the truck is the air compressor connected to?
questions.explanation: In an air brake system, the air compressor connects to the engine through gears or a belt.

questions.question: When backing a truck, what should you do?

options.text: Only use the side mirror on the driver's side.

questions.explanation: When backing a truck, always use both mirrors. Ask someone to help you whenever possible.

questions.question: What should a bus driver do while driving with passengers?

options.text: Do not talk with the passengers.
Ask passengers to watch for hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not talk with the passengers.
questions.explanation: A bus driver should not talk with passengers to avoid getting distracted.

questions.question: While driving, what holds spring brakes in place?
questions.explanation: While driving, air pressure holds spring brakes in place. If air pressure drops too low, the springs will activate the brakes.

questions.question: What should you do if the low pressure warning light comes on while driving?

options.text: Stop where you are and park.
Leave the road safely and park as soon as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave the road safely and park as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: If the low pressure warning light comes on, you must safely leave the road and park right away. If air pressure gets too low, your brakes will not work well enough to stop safely.

questions.question: What should a driver do if they start to feel tired while driving?
questions.explanation: If you feel drowsy, the only safe thing to do is leave the road safely and sleep. Using caffeine or other stimulants is dangerous because you will feel very tired when they wear off.

questions.question: What emergency equipment must a commercial motor vehicle have?

options.text: A fire extinguisher only if carrying hazardous materials.
A fire extinguisher only if traveling through remote areas.
A fire extinguisher and other emergency equipment.

questions.correctAnswerText: A fire extinguisher and other emergency equipment.
questions.explanation: All commercial motor vehicles must have proper emergency equipment. This includes spare fuses, three red reflective triangles or flares, and at least one charged fire extinguisher.

questions.question: What should a bus driver do before entering a curve?
questions.explanation: Always slow down before entering a curve. Be extra careful if the road is wet or slippery.

questions.question: When using spring brakes with a heavy load, how long will it take to stop?

options.text: It will be impossible to stop.
It will take a long time.
It will take a short time.

questions.correctAnswerText: It will take a long time.
questions.explanation: Spring brakes activate when air pressure gets too low. A heavy vehicle takes a long time to stop using only spring brakes because they do not work on all axles.

questions.question: If you see taillights ahead while driving in fog, what should you know?

options.text: The lights may not show where the road is. The vehicle may have left the road.
You can be sure the vehicle ahead is on the road.
It may be an optical illusion.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lights may not show where the road is. The vehicle may have left the road.
questions.explanation: In fog, lights are not reliable for finding the road. A vehicle's lights may come from a car that has pulled off the road.

questions.question: When visibility is low and you are near other drivers, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving near other drivers in low visibility conditions, such as at dawn, dusk, or in bad weather. High beams can make it hard for other drivers to see.

questions.question: What task is part of the CDL vehicle inspection test?
questions.explanation: The vehicle inspection test includes checking the oil level. You must show that the oil is at a safe level.

questions.question: When parking on a flat surface, what should you do?

options.text: Use wheel chocks to keep your vehicle from moving.
Use wheel chocks only after you apply the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use wheel chocks to keep your vehicle from moving.
questions.explanation: Always use wheel chocks when parking on a level surface. If your vehicle does not have spring brakes, wheel chocks are essential to prevent the trailer from moving.

questions.question: An open car window in cold weather may show that the driver is:
questions.explanation: Watch for signs that another driver may be impaired. Drivers who have drunk alcohol, are tired, are using drugs, or are sick can be dangerous. A driver with their window open in cold weather may be impaired.

questions.question: What is road rage?

options.text: Driving with the intent to harm others
Driving a vehicle that is unsafe
Driving a vehicle that has not been inspected

questions.correctAnswerText: Driving with the intent to harm others
questions.explanation: Aggressive driving is selfish or pushy driving. Road rage is driving with the intent to harm others or to physically hurt another driver or their vehicle.

questions.question: What may you be asked to do during a basic vehicle control skills test?

options.text: Drive straight into a parking space.

questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: A vehicle must have at least two mirrors.
questions.explanation: For safe driving, you need to see all sides of your vehicle. Vehicles should have mirrors on both sides. Check them regularly.

questions.question: When do skids happen?

options.text: When tires lose grip on the road.
When there is too much weight in the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: When tires lose grip on the road.
questions.explanation: Skids happen when tires lose traction with the road. This can be caused by braking too hard, accelerating too fast, turning too sharply, or driving too fast.

questions.question: How many classes of hazardous materials exist?
questions.explanation: Hazardous materials are divided into nine classes. Each class describes the type of risk the material poses.
